subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should this issue remain the broad Telegram reset/delivery reliability umbrella, or be narrowed to reset/session binding durability with separate follow-ups for delivery diagnostics and reset UX?
rationale: Current main partially fixes related symptoms, but the remaining ask spans product-visible behavior and multiple owner boundaries that automation should not choose without maintainer direction.

options.title: Narrow To Reset Durability
options.body: Keep this issue focused on making reset bindings durable before visibility or self-healing missing transcript files on inbound, and open or link narrower follow-ups for diagnostics and UX.

options.title: Sponsor Full Reliability Umbrella
options.body: Keep the full issue open as a larger maintainer-owned Telegram/session reliability project covering reset, progress, delivery, and usage diagnostics together.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open but require fresh Telegram Desktop or Crabbox proof before any new code work is queued.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Reset Durability
recommendation.body: Keep this issue focused on making reset bindings durable before visibility or self-healing missing transcript files on inbound, and open or link narrower follow-ups for diagnostics and UX.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent session architecture and linked subcase closure history and is the best available owner for deciding scope versus split follow-ups.
